def test_evaluate_numexpr_local_dict_fix():

    This is a regression test for the fix where right_op was incorrectly passed

        left_op=left_array, 
        right_op=right_array
    )

    expected = np.array([3, 4, 5, 6])
    np.testing.assert_array_equal(result, expected)
